text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year 
came to an end, and Mejiro Ramonu was...—

Honed by rigorous training, her body 
radiated an even fiercer aura, almost as 
if crowned with a halo—

—...It felt as though it was so. She 
herself must have found the training camp 
satisfying as well.
choice_data_list:
I can't wait to see you give it your all 
in the race!

I'm really looking forward to seeing you 
give it your all in the race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have moved closer to perfection... I 
hope my partner will be the same.

"Come to think of it, some time has passed 
since they both stepped away from the 
front lines. Mr. C.B. has likely resumed 
race-oriented training, but..."
choice_data_list:
I wonder if Rudolf will be able to run 
again soon

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't know. What Rudolf is up to, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Were it I, I would never forget a love 
yearned for so deeply.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she'll ruminate on it. Even if 
it's only temporary..."

If Symboli Rudolf truly loves racing, she 
might still be training just as hard as 
she did during her active career.
choice_data_list:
(You'd think that would make her want to 
race, but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Your cheeks are red.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You got sunburned, didn't you? Go cool off 
inside the car.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think someone of high 
standing... would speak their true 
feelings to someone so full of openings?

And so, summer camp came to an end... As 
soon as we arrived at the academy, I 
headed to the student council room to hear 
what Symboli Rudolf had to say—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —So, you came straight here, then.
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to know the real you
I wanted to know the real you

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You look completely transformed from 
before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well, I shall answer your question.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm still keeping up with training. It's 
become a habit, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we set aside another focused training 
period, she should be able to enter the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However. I have already passed the baton 
to the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just want to dedicate myself 
entirely to the advancement of the 
Umamusume world.
choice_data_list:
Still, this is definitely gonna be 
legendary, right!?

Still, this is definitely gonna be 
legendary, right!?

text_block_list.text:
The showdown between Mr. C.B. and Symboli 
Rudolf garnered immense attention as a 
clash of Triple Crown Umamusume. And this 
time—

"Mejiro Ramonu, who left an impression 
practically synonymous with the Tiara 
route itself, is joining as well. To have 
so many exceptional figures gathered in a 
single era—"

They are in a position where they can 
choose their races now. Even so, if they 
desire a direct showdown and compete 
together—

If they can show us who is the strongest 
in the highest... the most supreme race, 
that race will surely be passed down for 
eternity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A dream, huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True, it'll probably drum up maximum hype 
in the moment. But it won't last forever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then I want to take a higher perspective 
and invest that time into the future as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even at this very moment, there are 
Umamusume pursuing new dreams and heading 
into the racing world..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is not a moment to spare. Now that I 
have taken a stand— I will not allow 
anyone to say we were too late.

—A true lover of racing. Wishing for its 
progress from a broader, higher 
perspective... truly befitting an 
"Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Ramonu surely despises me, thinking I 
fled from the turf, though."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How can things connect inside and outside 
the turf?

On the day the news broke that Symboli 
Rudolf was stepping back from the front 
lines, Mejiro Ramonu certainly showed 
rejection. But—I understand now.

"That's not rejection. Mejiro Ramonu is 
simply pursuing the ultimate race. And 
yet, Symboli Rudolf is stepping away, 
which is why—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Ah, forgive me... Your words 
were just so remarkably honest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you simply want to run with me, nothing 
could be more endearing.

Symboli Rudolf didn't answer; she merely 
smiled. Just like before... And yet, it 
left an entirely different impression now.

"After finishing our conversation and 
stepping out of the student council 
room... Mejiro Ramonu was waiting."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I told you so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "She will show up. Without fail."
choice_data_list:
To that end—I will claim a flawless 
victory.

text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Queen Elizabeth II Cup, I 
will run a race that stirs Symboli 
Rudolf's heart and gives her that final 
push.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Let us respectfully welcome our obstinate 
'Emperor.'"
